behavior.legalHoldEndpoints: POST, GET, and DELETE /api/workspaces/:organizationId/operations/legal-hold implemented with OWNER/ADMIN role authorization; non-privileged roles (EDITOR, CREATOR, ANALYST, CLIENT) rejected with 403; non-members rejected with 404
behavior.enableHold: POST /operations/legal-hold accepts reason and optional caseReference, emits immutable data.legal_hold.enabled event to AuditLog; duplicate enables return 409 Conflict
behavior.releaseHold: DELETE /operations/legal-hold accepts releaseReason, emits immutable data.legal_hold.released event to AuditLog; releasing when inactive returns 409 Conflict
behavior.lockedMutations: Active legal hold locks retention pruning (POST /operations/retention-prune) and member data deletion (DELETE /operations/members/:userId) with HTTP 423 Locked
behavior.tests: 17 unit tests in tests/data-governance.test.ts and 10 integration tests in tests/integration/data-export.test.ts verifying enable, inspect, release, conflict handling, 403 authorization rejections, and HTTP 423 lock enforcement

limits: Legal hold operates within the tenant boundary; system-wide infrastructure administration is not governed by tenant holds
Windows environment limits: full Compose verification runs on Linux CI
